name: clean-margins
description: A searchable board for current government cleaning contracts.

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m ruff check pipeline tests
scripts.test: pnpm run test:js && pnpm run test:python
scripts.test:python: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -v
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run build && pnpm run smoke
